Storm Column (CV 38)

A turning column of rain, grit and lightning with a dimly human outline at its center. Its shape continually reforms around the pressure of the wind holding it together.

HP: 30 · Speed: Ground 0; fly 7 · Footprint: 2x2

Summoned form — player reference.

Defense modifier: 1 Boon. · Stability: 1 (Heavy Frame, passive grant; not derived from size).

DR / resistance: lightning 3; Physical 1 · Condition immunities: Bleeding; Poisoned; Asleep

Weakness: None

Healing: Summoned energy form: cannot be healed; disappears at 0 HP without leaving a body. Cannot swallow potions.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Communication: None

Attributes: Brawn +1; Fortitude +2; Agility +2; Guile +0; Knowledge +0; Reason +1

Eligibility: Elemental 7

Main command: Main + Maneuver; Maneuver command: Maneuver + movement. One command per summon per controller turn; immediate summoning command counts. No activity or alerts without a command; no Reactions or opportunity attacks. Turn ticks use controller’s turn. Beyond 6 squares, or controller unconscious/dead, it disappears; at 0 HP it disappears. No permanent loot.

Carrying: up to 1 Bulk; anatomy limits handling. No granted crafting training.

Roll its printed attack attribute and read the attacker outcomes below. When it is attacked, roll the defense attribute named by the incoming attack. Passive defenses remain; no independent active effects.

Attacks — Main Action

AttackAttributeAttack modifierWeak attackStandard attackStrong attack
Forked flashReason1 Boon4 lightning damage.6 lightning damage. Burning 1.8 lightning damage. Burning 2.
Driving gustReason1 BoonNo damage. Push 1.No damage. Push 2.No damage. Push 3.

Forked flash: One visible creature within 6 squares.

Driving gust: All creatures in a line 6 from this creature.

Maneuvers

Wind Step — Maneuver

The body uncoils into a ribbon of air and gathers at the edge of the gust.

Move up to 3 squares using a printed movement mode without provoking from one visible enemy chosen before moving. Pay normal terrain costs and provoke normally from other enemies. Cannot pass through solid objects or occupied squares.

Use only as part of a command; no independent activity.

Defend — Maneuver: gain 1 Boon to defenses until the start of the controller’s next turn; repeated Defend does not stack.

Basic Melee — Main: 1 Boon to attack; Brawn, one adjacent target; Weak attack 2, Standard 3, Strong 5 physical damage. No specialty riders. No opportunity Reaction.
